subject: ss-medical-oncology
title: HER2-positive breast cancer: receptor testing, targeted antibody backbones and cardiac safety

steps.tx: Accurate pathological assessment of human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 dictates systemic therapy eligibility. According to updated **ASCO/CAP guidelines**, immunohistochemistry **IHC 3+** defined as intense circumferential membrane staining in greater than 10% of invasive tumour cells establishes HER2 positivity. Equivocal IHC 2+ cases mandate reflex **in situ hybridization** ISH; positivity requires a HER2-to-CEP17 copy number ratio of 2.0 or higher, or an absolute HER2 gene copy number of 6.0 or greater per cell.
steps.say: Accurate pathological assessment of human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 dictates systemic therapy eligibility. According to updated ASCO/CAP guidelines, immunohistochemistry IHC 3+ defined as intense circumferential membrane staining in over 10% of tumour cells establishes positivity. Equivocal IHC 2+ cases require reflex in situ hybridization, where a ratio of 2.0 or higher confirms amplification.

steps.tx: Extending dual-epitope receptor blockade to the neoadjuvant setting substantially increases complete response rates. Neoadjuvant chemotherapy combining a taxane with dual anti-HER2 monoclonal antibodies **trastuzumab** and **pertuzumab** constitutes standard care for stage II and III HER2-positive breast cancer. Trastuzumab binds extracellular subdomain IV preventing receptor cleavage, while pertuzumab binds subdomain II blocking **HER2-HER3 dimerization**, producing pathologically complete remission rates approaching 60% to 70%.
steps.say: Extending dual-epitope receptor blockade to the neoadjuvant setting substantially increases complete response rates. Neoadjuvant chemotherapy combining a taxane with dual antibodies trastuzumab and pertuzumab constitutes standard care for early HER2-positive breast cancer. Trastuzumab binds subdomain IV, while pertuzumab binds subdomain II blocking HER2-HER3 dimerization, achieving complete response rates up to 70%.

left.title: Trastuzumab (Herceptin)
points: Binds extracellular subdomain IV of HER2

right.title: Pertuzumab (Perjeta)
points: Potently shuts down PI3K-AKT survival signalling

steps.tx: Residual invasive disease identified at definitive surgical resection heralds a heightened risk of metastatic recurrence. In the randomized phase 3 **KATHERINE trial**, patients with residual invasive breast carcinoma following neoadjuvant taxane and trastuzumab-based chemotherapy were switched to adjuvant **trastuzumab emtansine** T-DM1 for 14 cycles. Adjuvant T-DM1 produced a 50% reduction in invasive disease recurrence or death compared to continuing standard trastuzumab monotherapy.

In the randomized phase 3 KATHERINE trial, patients with residual invasive disease following neoadjuvant chemotherapy were switched to adjuvant trastuzumab emtansine T-DM1 for 14 cycles. Adjuvant T-DM1 produced a 50% reduction in invasive recurrence compared to trastuzumab.

steps.tx: The definitive first-line standard for metastatic HER2-positive disease combines dual antibody blockade with taxane chemotherapy. Established by the landmark **CLEOPATRA trial**, first-line therapy comprises docetaxel, trastuzumab, and pertuzumab. This triplet combination achieved an extraordinary median overall survival exceeding 57 months, establishing persistent dual-HER2 blockade as the worldwide standard. Following docetaxel completion, dual monoclonal antibody maintenance is continued until objective disease progression.
steps.say: The definitive first-line standard for metastatic HER2-positive disease combines dual antibody blockade with taxane chemotherapy. Established by the landmark CLEOPATRA trial, first-line therapy comprises docetaxel, trastuzumab, and pertuzumab. This triplet combination achieved a median overall survival exceeding 57 months. Following chemotherapy, dual antibody maintenance is continued until disease progression.

steps.tx: Second-line therapy for metastatic disease has been fundamentally redefined by next-generation antibody-drug conjugates. In the head-to-head randomized **DESTINY-Breast03 trial**, **trastuzumab deruxtecan** T-DXd demonstrated unequivocal superiority over trastuzumab emtansine T-DM1 in patients with progressive metastatic HER2-positive disease. T-DXd reduced the risk of disease progression or death by 72%, establishing T-DXd as the undisputed global second-line standard.

right.title: Trastuzumab Emtansine (Prior Standard)
points: Lower rate of interstitial lung disease

steps.tx: Small-molecule tyrosine kinase inhibitors penetrate the blood-brain barrier to treat active brain metastases. In the randomized **HER2CLIMB trial**, adding the selective HER2 oral tyrosine kinase inhibitor **tucatinib** to trastuzumab and capecitabine significantly prolonged progression-free and overall survival in patients with pre-treated metastatic disease. Uniquely, this survival benefit was confirmed in patients with active, progressive, or untreated brain metastases, a patient population historically excluded from clinical trials.

Uniquely, this benefit extended to patients with active brain metastases.

steps.tx: Receptor expression below classical amplification thresholds now represents a therapeutically targetable entity. The seminal **DESTINY-Breast04 trial** proved that **trastuzumab deruxtecan** produces statistically significant progression-free and overall survival improvements in metastatic **HER2-low** breast cancer, defined as IHC 1+ or IHC 2+ with negative ISH. T-DXd bystander cytotoxicity effectively eradicates tumours lacking gene amplification, demolishing the classical binary classification of HER2 status.

steps.tx: Targeting HER2 carries class-specific cardiovascular toxicity requiring structured surveillance. **Trastuzumab cardiotoxicity** presents as Type II cardiotoxicity, defined by asymptomatic left ventricular ejection fraction LVEF decline that is typically reversible, not dose-dependent, and devoid of ultrastructural myocyte necrosis on biopsy. Serial echocardiographic **LVEF monitoring** is mandatory every 3 months during adjuvant therapy, holding treatment if LVEF drops below 50% or by at least 10% from baseline.
